request.text: My old dog Luna needs her joint supplement tonight. Please schedule a reminder for 9:00 PM on August 31, 2026 saying 'Give Luna her joint supplement,' and tell me it's already set so I can stop worrying.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for August 31, 2026 at 9:00 PM to give Luna her joint supplement.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder for Luna's evening joint supplement.
new_goals.source_text: Please schedule a reminder for 9:00 PM on August 31, 2026 saying 'Give Luna her joint supplement,' and tell me it's already set so I can stop worrying.
success_criteria: A reminder to give Luna her joint supplement is created for August 31, 2026 at 9:00 PM.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The requested reassurance is tied to one new reminder outcome and does not create a separate speech Goal.

semantic_facts: The Plan should prepare one reminder Work item with Luna's supplement text and the exact 9:00 PM due time.
